context.transcript:
Hi Pauline.
I'm calling to let you know that we finished working on the walkway at your new place.
There are no more broken stones and we replaced the filler between all the stones.
I know you wanted your backyard deck done by the end of the week before you move in, but we have several new crew members on the project.
I think you'll be very pleased with how everything looks so far though.
I'll send you some photographs this afternoon so you can see for yourself.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，Pauline。
我打电话来是想通知您，我们在您新住处的步道施工已经完成了。
没有更多的碎石了，我们已经重新填补了所有石头之间的空隙。
我知道您希望在搬进来前一周结束时完成后院露台，但我们的项目有几位新的工人。
不过，我想您会非常满意目前的一切外观的。
我今天下午会给您发送一些照片，这样您可以亲眼看看。
